title: Slack: the vendor tip did not work on TRN-229
description: Follow-up of slack-vendor-secondhand. The field engineer waited as the vendor tip said, the link stayed down, and a reboot fixed it. The new, verified advice is kept for TRN-229 only, and it must be flagged in conflict with the vendor hunch (same topic, same node, other author, other action). One node is not proof for every TX-5000, so the hunch is not closed.
subject: #transmission

incident.summary: TRN-229 link still down after waiting for sync

messages.text: update on TRN-229: waited 25 min like the vendor said, link still DOWN, alarms still on. so I did a reboot anyway, link came UP in about 3 minutes and alarms cleared.
thanks for reporting back. so the vendor tip did not hold, at least on 229. I'll push back on them.
One node is not proof for all TX-5000s. But on 229, waiting did nothing and the reboot fixed it.
yep. next time on 229 I'd reboot straight away.

items.diagnosis: waiting for sync did not bring the link back on TRN-229
items.action: Reboot the node: on TRN-229 the link came back about 3 minutes after a reboot; waiting 25 minutes did nothing.
items.summary: On TRN-229, waiting for sync after a power dip did not work (25 minutes, link still down); a reboot restored the link in about 3 minutes.
